name: zclass_camera_set_variant_tag_override
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraSetVariantTagOverride validates a camera node and applies a non-empty complete variant tag override to its camera data.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x44d260 validates camera validation, return 5 for null node/data, return 3 for non-camera class, counted tag scan clearing validity on any 0xff within count, no override when count is zero or invalid, setting cameraData->variantOverrideEnabled to 1 for complete non-empty tags, packed zTag4 copy into cameraData->variantTag, and return 0 for valid camera calls.
The native zclass_camera_view_distance_smoke now verifies successful complete-tag application plus incomplete-tag and zero-count no-op behavior on camera data.
known_limits: No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x44d260 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
